mentions.name: ebpfence
mentions.description: An experimental security tool named ebpfence that automatically blocks stealer malware from stealing user credentials or crypto wallets, inspired by the Shai-Hulud attack.
mentions.problem: Protects credentials and crypto wallets from being stolen by credential-stealing malware.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Im working on ebpfence https://github.com/CucumisSativus/ebpfence

I want to create a tool that would automatically block the stealers from stealing your previous credentials or crypto wallets.
